pr_title: util: avoid spilling to disk after rowContainer has been closed.
pr_body:
<!-- Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

PR Title Format:
1. pkg [, pkg2, pkg3]: what's changed
2. *: what's changed

-->

### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/19730 <!-- REMOVE this line if no issue to close -->

Problem Summary: (Race in branch 4.0 now)
Race in memory.(*Tracker).Consume() and memory.(*Tracker).DetachFromGlobalTracker() to compete the field t.parent.
Root Cause:
1. SpillToDisk will attach tracker to session tracker, although the rowContainer has been closed.
2. Consume don't check the bytes whether is 0. (Check in master, not 4.0)
3. DetachFromGlobalTracker doesn't add a lock to change t.parent. (Lock in master, not 4.0)

### What is changed and how it works?

Proposal: [xxx](url) <!-- REMOVE this line if not applicable -->

What's Changed:
Fix the Root Cause 1.

How it Works:

- Need to cherry-pick to the release branch 4.0

- No release note
